clue.text: The breaking position?

parts.note: the break in a match is the interval between halves, and the position then is how the teams stand on the scoreboard

explanation.definitionFit: The tally at the interval of a football match is the standing at the break.

clue.text: One enters car scheme for device to keep on course

parts.note: auto is short for automobile, a car

indicators.note: one piece goes into another, so the letter for one sits inside the scheme word

parts.note: a plot is a scheme
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone joins a motoring plan in order to get a navigation gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: An automatic steering system holds an aircraft or ship on its set heading.

clue.text: Bob put forward an idea

definitions.meaning: to bob is to sit buoyantly on water
to suggest or propose a plan tentatively

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: a buoyant bobbing thing, and proposing a notion to test reactions.

clue.text: One to 3, mainly hidden from sight

definitions.text: One to 3, mainly hidden from sight

parts.words: One to 3, mainly hidden from sight
parts.note: 3 down is the answer meaning bob on water, so this is something that does that while most of its bulk stays below the surface

explanation.definitionFit: A mass of drifting frozen water floats with about nine tenths of its bulk submerged.

clue.text: Absorb and learn about the short sort

indicators.note: one piece goes round another, so the rearranged letters surround the shortened word
to sort is to rearrange, so the letters of learn are reordered
short means the word loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Engross yourself and study the clipped kind of person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sort' makes ENRAL and 'short' makes TH; the surface's 'short sort' reads as a small person, hiding both signals.
explanation.definitionFit: To enthral someone is to captivate or absorb their whole attention.

clue.text: Body meeting to pledge help to golfers?

parts.note: to commit is to pledge or bind oneself
a tee is the peg that holds a golf ball up for the drive

explanation.surface: An assembly gathers to promise support for players on the links.
explanation.definitionFit: A committee is an appointed group of people, a body acting together.

clue.text: Old memorial in state of dereliction

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the longer word that follows

explanation.surface: An ancient monument has fallen into ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: A relic is something surviving from the past, kept as a reminder of it.

clue.text: Have control of metal by sheet on ground

parts.note: lead is a heavy metal
taken as written

indicators.note: ground means crushed and broken up, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Something metallic sits by a sheet laid on the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to dominate someone completely, as a bull is led by a nose ring.

clue.text: All aboard!

parts.note: read not as a call to board but as a description of everyone who is on the ship or plane, written down

explanation.definitionFit: A manifest of travellers names everyone who is aboard a vessel or aircraft.

clue.text: Amiable chap edited text about dog

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap round the dog's name
editing changes the text, so its letters are reordered

parts.note: Rover is a traditional name for a dog

explanation.surface: A friendly man revised a piece of writing about his pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'edited' gives EXTT, split by the dog; Rover is the stock crossword dog.
explanation.definitionFit: An outgoing, sociable person is the opposite of an introvert, typically friendly.

clue.text: Graduate's sporting association in the island

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate
LTA is the Lawn Tennis Association, the body governing British tennis

explanation.surface: A university alumnus belongs to a sports body on an island.
explanation.definitionFit: Malta is a Mediterranean island nation south of Sicily.

clue.text: Drank a lot back at the store

indicators.note: back means the word is read in the reverse direction

parts.note: to tope is to drink heavily, an old word

explanation.surface: Someone drank heavily at the back of the shop.
explanation.definitionFit: A depot is a warehouse or storage place for goods.

clue.text: Ease price put out to the listeners?

indicators.note: put out means disturbed, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A lower cost is announced to an audience.
explanation.definitionFit: Headphone units sit in the ears and let wearers hear, so they are playfully called listeners.

clue.text: The old line on fish making a noise

parts.note: ye is an archaic form of the
the ling is a sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: An archaic line about seafood is being shouted.
explanation.definitionFit: Shouting loudly is a way of making a noise.

clue.text: End of rope in tangle could be this

definitions.text: End of rope in tangle could be this

indicators.note: the letters could be rearranged into something else, an anagram signal
the last letter of the following word is taken

explanation.surface: A knotted rope's end looks clumsy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'End of' takes E from rope; 'could be' rearranges E plus IN TANGLE. The whole clue is also the definition: a rope end caught in a tangle looks clumsy.
explanation.definitionFit: A snarled rope end is awkward and lacking in grace, which is what clumsy-looking means.

clue.text: A language, possibly vital one

indicators.note: possibly signals the letters could form another word when rearranged

parts.note: an is the indefinite article, meaning one

explanation.surface: Some tongue may be an essential one.
explanation.definitionFit: Latvian is the Baltic tongue spoken in Latvia.

clue.text: Ration one — it's exceptional as a starter

indicators.note: exceptional means out of the ordinary, so the letters take an unusual order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one
it is taken as written, the apostrophe-s being a link

explanation.surface: An allowance for one person is unusual for a first course.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who starts or originates something is its initiator.

clue.text: Fiery boss, an impetuous one

parts.note: hot means fiery
a head is a boss or chief

explanation.surface: A hot-tempered manager acts rashly.
explanation.definitionFit: A rash, quick-tempered person acts on impulse.

clue.text: Pitch assistance turning up over ball game

indicators.note: in a down answer over means placed above the next piece
in a down answer turning up reads the letters bottom to top, reversing both pieces

parts.note: to lob is to pitch or toss high
aid means assistance
O is shaped like a ball

explanation.surface: A thrown ball comes after help arrives on the field.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' gives DIABOL; in a down clue 'over' puts it above O.
explanation.definitionFit: Diabolo is a juggling toy game with a spool spun on a string between two sticks.

clue.text: Prompt about the introduction of Edwardian past

indicators.note: the word for punctual goes round the letter

parts.note: prompt means on time, punctual

indicators.note: the introduction is the first letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A punctual arrival recalls an Edwardian era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prompt' looks like a verb but is the adjective meaning punctual.
explanation.definitionFit: Former or erstwhile, describing what was so in the past.

clue.text: Peculiar people with time for a scrap

parts.note: odd means peculiar
men means people

explanation.surface: Strange folk take a while over a leftover.
explanation.definitionFit: An oddment is a leftover bit or fragment, a scrap.

clue.text: Sort of carer? My charges could be small

definitions.text: Sort of carer? My charges could be small

parts.words: Sort of carer? My charges could be small
parts.note: a carer whose wards are young children, the charges being little ones rather than fees

explanation.definitionFit: A woman employed to look after small children is a nanny-type carer.

clue.text: Clock up and send money in payment

indicators.note: in a down answer up means the word is read from the bottom

parts.note: a timer is a clock

explanation.surface: Run the meter and pay what is due.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: remitting is transmitting funds to settle a bill or debt.

clue.text: Screen cook

definitions.meaning: a lattice or barred screen over an opening

explanation.definitionFit: A grating or barred screen, and to cook food under radiant heat.

clue.text: Wolf in the valley?

definitions.meaning: to wolf food is to eat it greedily
a narrow valley with steep rocky sides

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: to eat ravenously, and a steep-sided ravine.

clue.text: It leaves scope in South America for the dance

indicators.note: the shortened word goes inside the abbreviation
leaves means departs, so the word it goes out of the scope word

parts.note: ambit means scope or range
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something exits a range in South America for a dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' takes IT out of AMBIT, giving AMB, which goes 'in' SA.
explanation.definitionFit: The samba is a lively Brazilian dance.

clue.text: Thinks too highly of what concerns cricketers

definitions.meaning: values something more than it deserves
in cricket an over rate is the speed at which a team bowls its six-ball sets, a matter of concern to players

explanation.definitionFit: To overvalue something, and the bowling speed measured in six-ball sets in cricket.

clue.text: Condition of the (very best) paintings?

parts.note: state means condition
taken as written
paintings are art

explanation.surface: Assessing the condition of the finest pictures.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes the most advanced or best available, the very best.
